keywords: Partition action – Roman-Dutch law – Community of property between spouses – Community of debts – Fiscal sale – Wife’s share liable for husband’s contractual debt – Devolution of title – 1/12 share – Fiscal conveyance of 1861 – District Judge’s erroneous allotment – Separate property reforms – Pre-1876 marriages – Servitude/right to draw water from well – Purpose of partition to terminate inconvenience of co-ownership – Exclusive use of well – Improvements and plantations – Claim before surveyor – Variation of District Court allotments – Appeal allowed to extent of variations.
